== Description ==
'''LAPSE-1''' is one of the many Lapse entity you may encounter, serving as an I variant to [[SHA-1]].

== Behavior ==
Upon spawning, LAPSE-1 will take on one of two mechanics.

His first mechanic is putting a red outline with very faint red coloring on 75% of every hiding spot in every room. He will then rush forward and break the door, and break every highlighted locker. Functioning similary to SHA-1, but more aggressive and overall more difficult.

His alternate mechanic is putting a stronger recoloring highlight of red without an outline on 1-3 lockers in every room. He will then break the door the same way he does in his other mechanic, and then check every locker he '''Didn't''' highlight. 

In both mechanics, he breaks doors down, and breaks lockers he checks. He also has a chance to spawn SHA-2 and SHA-55.

== Strategy & Tips ==
* [[Claustrophobia]] can attack while '''LAPSE-1''' active, so leave the locker when it is far from you.
* quickly try to identify if '''LAPSE-1''' outlined or highlighted lockers and hide correctly.
* '''LAPSE-1''' can't kill you if you are not fully hidden, and he also makes [[Claustrophobia]] take longer to attack. Use this to your advantage.
* '''LAPSE-1''''s instakill can be avoided by dodge-rolling, use this in dire situations when no unmarked hiding spots are available! You will still be damaged as if you were being locker-sniped though.
* '''LAPSE-1''' takes longer to reach the main room in the [[Section M]], so also use it as your advantage.

== Trivia ==
* '''LAPSE-1''' was released when [[Perfection Event 2/13/26]] started, alongside [[SHA-4]], [[SHA-7]], [[SHA-22]], [[SHA-150]], and the [[Overseer]]. 
* In the [[April Fools 2026]] update, '''LAPSE-1''' replaces [[SHA-1]] in [[Alpha & Shadowpocalypse]] at door A-020.
** However, It wont award you the badge.
** This is no longer possible to reproduce due to the [[April Fools 2026]] event becoming a modifier, and [[Alpha & Shadowpocalypse]] modifier only being usable without other modifiers.
